Freeze reachable candidates and version-availability outcomes in one catalog. Cache candidate capability records while retaining the prior capability-discovery closure, without global selection or candidate activation.

Use the same catalog for existing plan solve, manifest observation, held-pin retry, visibility masking and conditional reads within that transaction. Direct resolvo solves cache repeated provider reads independently.

Propagate operational/corrupt metadata errors; preserve typed absence and version-incompatibility outcomes. Check selected source bindings before acquisition and enforce captured content/definition before store insertion.
Keep B3 opt-in grammar and ordinary install parser unchanged. Defer migration persistence until catalog-backed planning succeeds; fresh-lock migration still persists.
